en:
I don't care who it is, I'm not letting anyone
through. Now, goodbye.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki's been here this whole time...
She must really not want anyone to enter.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Maki?
Spend time with Maki Harukawa Event 5
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
